description: §40.8 — one `<page>` in a `<program>` is not E-PAGE-DUPLICATE (clean twin of e-page-duplicate-pos).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4
rationale: §40.8: a `<program>` MAY contain zero or one `<page>`; only a second one is E-PAGE-DUPLICATE.
